Hi Mina —

We're seeing an ACH we sent on 2026-10-17 for $75,000 (ref: BT-789123) landed against 'Redwood, Inc.' (US entity) in your systems, but our PO and contract are under the Redwood EMEA entity (Locke Motors EU VAT: EU-44217). Can you confirm whether this can be re-applied to the EMEA ledger and the correct invoice?

Attached is the remittance we received from our bank (remittance_20261017.pdf). The invoices we intended to pay are: INV-4472 (EUR 42,500) and INV-4490 (EUR 18,000) — the remainder was prepayment for an upcoming volume credit.

We need the payment moved on your end (if possible) and a confirmation of whether you need a credit memo or corrected invoice for VAT reporting. Our AP team is running the bank trace and I will forward once ready. Can we get a timeline? We have quarter-end reporting and need clarity by end of week.

Thanks,

Hi Emily — thanks for flagging and for the remittance. I've looped in Grace (AR) and Marissa (Billing) to evaluate re-application and tax impact. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Can you please confirm the original bank trace or ACH confirmation when available (BT-789123)? That will let us match the bank settlement id.
- If the payment did land to the US entity ledger, we can execute an internal journal transfer to move funds to the EMEA ledger and then reapply to INV-4472/INV-4490. That will require a reversing revenue allocation for INV-4472 if revenue was recognized under the US entity.
- For VAT, Marissa and Laura (tax review) will confirm whether we issue a credit memo or a corrected invoice for EMEA reporting. If you prefer a credit memo + new EMEA invoice, we can do that and provide supporting docs for your VAT team.

Tentative timeline: Grace will scope the AR re-apply + journal correction today; if bank trace matches remittance, target to reflect in AR by 2026-10-20. Marissa will draft a customer-facing remittance confirmation and note on VAT.

I'll update you as soon as we have the bank trace and the journal entries ready.

Best,

Thanks Mina — I reviewed the ledger and draft a correction approach below. Posting here so everyone has the proposed GL impact and steps.

Plan (high level):
1) Reverse apply payment on Redwood US ledger: create reversing journal to move $75,000 from Cash - Redwood US (GL 1012) to Suspense AR (GL 2019) so US invoices are left unpaid.
2) Create intercompany transfer JE to post $75,000 to Redwood EMEA cash (GL 3010) with intercompany clearing line (GL 4080).
3) On EMEA AR, apply $75,000 to INV-4472 (EUR 42,500) and INV-4490 (EUR 18,000) using exchange rate 1.09 (bank rate on 2026-10-17). Remaining EUR prepayment to be held as customer credit.
4) If revenue was recognized under US entity for INV-4472, post a reversing revenue entry on US P&L and post revenue on EMEA P&L (timing flagged for finance close).

Actions needed from tax/rev recognition: Laura — need confirmation whether the reversing revenue + re-recognition in EMEA is acceptable for our statutory close (will this require a carve-out or additional disclosure?). Also confirm whether we should issue a credit memo or a corrective invoice for VAT reporting.

Attachments: I put a draft workbook of the JE lines in journal_correction_draft.xlsx for accounting to sign-off. If AP sends bank trace (BT-789123), I can run the AR apply on 10/20 EOD.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
